segments.caption: Your script works.

segments.caption: Then somebody clones the repository and gets an import error.
segments.spoken: Then somebody clones the repository and gets an import error.

segments.caption: You send them three extra commands in a message.
segments.spoken: You send them three extra commands in a message.

segments.caption: A week later, somebody else needs the same three commands.
segments.spoken: A week later, somebody else needs the same three commands.

segments.caption: That is a setup problem you can fix before the project gets complicated.
segments.spoken: That is a setup problem you can fix before the project gets complicated.

segments.caption: Start with a terminal inside your project.
segments.spoken: Start with a terminal inside your project.

segments.caption: Run pwd to check where you are, then git status to see what Git knows about this directory.
segments.spoken: Run P W D to check where you are, then git status to see what Git knows about this directory.

segments.caption: Relative paths start from your current directory.
segments.spoken: Relative paths start from your current directory.

segments.caption: If a command cannot find a file, check that location before changing the code.
segments.spoken: If a command cannot find a file, check that location before changing the code.

segments.caption: Create a virtual environment with python -m venv .venv.
segments.spoken: Create a virtual environment with python, dash m, v e n v, dot v e n v.

segments.caption: On macOS or Linux, activate it with source .venv/bin/activate.
segments.spoken: On macOS or Linux, activate it with source, dot v e n v, slash bin slash activate.

segments.caption: On Windows PowerShell, use the activation script under .venv/Scripts.
segments.spoken: On Windows PowerShell, use the activation script under dot v e n v, slash scripts.

segments.caption: Now python -m pip points at the installer for that interpreter.
segments.spoken: Now python dash m pip points at the installer for that interpreter.

segments.caption: Install your one dependency, then capture the versions in requirements.txt.
segments.spoken: Install your one dependency, then capture the versions in requirements dot t x t.

segments.caption: This gives the next person something specific to install.
segments.spoken: This gives the next person something specific to install.

segments.caption: Before staging anything, add the environment directory, local secrets, and raw data to .gitignore.
segments.spoken: Before staging anything, add the environment directory, local secrets, and raw data to dot git ignore.

segments.caption: An ignore rule keeps an untracked file out of future staging.
segments.spoken: An ignore rule keeps an untracked file out of future staging.

segments.caption: It does not remove something you already committed.
segments.spoken: It does not remove something you already committed.

segments.caption: Think of it as the guest list at the door; it cannot erase yesterday's attendance record.
segments.spoken: Think of it as the guest list at the door; it cannot erase yesterday's attendance record.

segments.caption: Now watch the three Git states.
segments.spoken: Now watch the three Git states.

segments.caption: Edit a file: that changes your working tree.
segments.spoken: Edit a file: that changes your working tree.

segments.caption: Run git add: that selects its current contents for your next commit.
segments.spoken: Run git add: that selects its current contents for your next commit.

segments.caption: Run git commit: that records the staged snapshot locally.
segments.spoken: Run git commit: that records the staged snapshot locally.

segments.caption: A push transfers commits to a remote.
segments.spoken: A push transfers commits to a remote.

segments.caption: Check git diff and git diff --staged so you know exactly which snapshot you are recording.
segments.spoken: Check git diff and git diff, dash dash staged so you know exactly which snapshot you are recording.

segments.caption: For the lab, keep your baseline small.
segments.spoken: For the lab, keep your baseline small.

segments.caption: Make a feature branch, add the environment check, README, and decision note in separate meaningful commits, and review the pull request before merging.
segments.spoken: Make a feature branch, add the environment check, read me, and decision note in separate meaningful commits, and review the pull request before merging.

segments.caption: Follow the course's three-commit exercise without stretching one change into artificial commits.
segments.spoken: Follow the course's three-commit exercise without stretching one change into artificial commits.

segments.caption: Then do the part that proves the README works: use a fresh clone, create and activate a new environment, install from the requirements file, and run the check.
segments.spoken: Then do the part that proves the read me works: use a fresh clone, create and activate a new environment, install from the requirements file, and run the check.

segments.caption: Do not rely on the environment you already repaired by hand.
segments.spoken: Do not rely on the environment you already repaired by hand.

segments.caption: Your evidence is a successful clean setup and a reviewable history.
segments.spoken: Your evidence is a successful clean setup and a reviewable history.
